notes.title: Beta 0.70: Raiders, GOAP AI, 3D Printing & Visual Upgrades

Survivors, get ready to face cunning Raiders, craft with 3D Printers, and experience upgraded visuals, and Survivor NPCs are on the way :D

[b]Update Summary[/b]

[list]
[*] Added Human Enemies - Raiders.
[*] Completed the GOAP AI framework.
[*] Unlocked large map options.
[*] Unlocked 3D Printing skill tree.
[*] Added constructible Battery Charging Station.
[*] Added constructible 3D Printer.
[*] Batteries can now be recharged.
[*] Added magnified scope effect when aiming.
[*] New location: Train Station Raider Camp.
[*] Upgraded zombie limb destruction effects.
[*] Added airflow and sonic wave visual effects.
[*] Lone Raiders may appear inside buildings.
[*] Rooms now spawn miscellaneous clutter on the floor.
[*] New items: Ammo crates, suitcases, clothing, accessories, and more.
[*] Added human corpse texture generation.
[*] Fixed issues with zombie sound effects.
[*] Fixed display errors for wire connections.
[*] Optimized character clothing layer rendering.
[*] Optimized character skin tone settings.
[*] Optimized character models and animations.
[*] Bug fixes, performance optimizations, and other improvements.
[/list]

[b]Human Enemies - Raiders[/b]

A small number of Raiders will randomly spawn across the map.
The new Train Station location will spawn a Raider camp.
Raiders can use all weapons available to players, including firearms, crossbows, bows, and melee weapons.
When forming squads, Raiders will perform tactical maneuvers such as flanking, throwing grenades, and suppressive fire.

[b]GOAP AI[/b]

Implemented human AI using the GOAP framework.
Actions are selected through decision trees.
The enemies in the classic FPS game “F.E.A.R.” were also created using the GOAP framework.
Compared to state machines, this more complex decision-making system delivers a more engaging gameplay experience.
Friendly or neutral human NPCs will be updated soon.

[b]Visual Upgrades[/b]

High-magnification scopes now feature a zoom effect, enlarging the targeted area.
Bullets now have more realistic airflow effects.
Explosions and alarms emit shockwave effects.
Zombie limb destruction effects are now more realistic and precise.

[b]Scope Aiming[/b], simulated lens distortion and chromatic aberration.

[b]3D Printing and Battery Charging[/b]

Added two new constructible items.
The Charging Station can recharge batteries.
The 3D Printer can craft various items. (More printable weapons and items will be added in future updates.)

In future updates, players will be able to upload their current characters to the server.
These characters will appear in other players' games.

notes.title: The lag issue caused by the physics system fixed
notes.content:
After the last update,  
we received some feedback regarding [b]abnormal lag in the game[/b].  
With the help of the player community,  
I was able to get the save file that triggered the lag  
and conducted an urgent investigation.

I found that the issue was caused by the character's [b]physics system[/b] settings.  
However, in the last update, I only modified the vehicle physics system  
and did not make any changes to the character physics.  
This issue may have been caused by a bug in the game engine that altered my settings.

After identifying the problem,  
I immediately implemented the necessary fix.  
The latest version should no longer experience this abnormal lag.

I apologize for the inconvenience caused. As the developer, I truly regret this issue.  
Every major update has the potential to introduce new problems,  
but most of them are quickly resolved.

notes.title: Zed Zone APACALYPSE AHEAD will release on 3.29.2023 with Early Access.
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=lMJ1gsAFTko;full][/previewyoutube]

My indie game "Zed Zone - APOCALYPSE AHEAD" has finally been released with Early Access. 
The game will be released on Steam on March 29, 2023 at 9pm PDT, in Early Access.
Thank you for your support and patience.
Your understanding and encouragement is my greatest motivation :D
 
If you are interested in the game, Please add it to your wishlist :D
 
Game description: Zed Zone - APOCALYPSE AHEAD is an open world survival and building game. Players have to survive in the zombie apocalypse world, scavenge for supplies, build bases, upgrade technology, and manufacture necessary supplies and equipment.
Explore this world, face danger and accidental death, and experience the joy of roasting in peace after danger.
 
And finally:
 
From the release of the first video of "Zed Zone" in August 19, to the video's 100,000 views, to the first version of the package, to the two internal tests, and now the upcoming "Early Access". I don't know, 4 years have passed quietly. I'd like to thank all of you on Discord and Twitter for your encouragement (and persistent reminders...) It really helped me.
 
It's not easy to develop an open world survival game like "Zed Zone-APOCALYPSE AHEAD" by yourself. The core reason is that one's mind is limited and can easily fall into a recursive thinking loop. This can lead to a period of time where you can't find the right direction, and often get stuck on a feature that's not really important. The biggest fear is not too much work, too difficult features, but an empty mind, no ideas.
 
Later, I conducted a small-scale internal test and received a lot of feedback, which provided me with a lot of ideas, and since then, development has been smoother than before.
So I think, for me, player testing is not just a formality, it is really part of development.
This is also the main reason why we choose to release it in the form of "Early Access".
 
In the future, we will continue to seek and refer to players' ideas and suggestions, and welcome players who like to pick up garbage in the end, to join us in the Early Access, to make a game that people love to play. That is the happiest.
 
 
Thank you for your continued support.

Thank you all! :D
